    rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA  := 0.0;

    rDemandedForce_FL_kN    := 0.0;
    rDemandedForce_FR_kN    := 0.0;
    rDemandedForce_RL_kN    := 0.0;
    rDemandedForce_RR_kN    := 0.0;
    rDemandedForce_LatF_kN  := 0.0;
    rDemandedForce_LatR_kN  := 0.0;

    bSystemReady            := FALSE;
    bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
    bFailsafeLockoutActive  := TRUE;
    wAlarmCriticalWord.0    := TRUE;    (* Alarm Bit 0: Hardware Emergency Loop Open *)
    iActiveState            := 70;      (* Transition Immediately to Lockout State *)
    RETURN;
ELSE
    wAlarmCriticalWord.0    := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* --- SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING ARCHITECTURE --- *)
(* 2.1 Lateral Accelerometer CG Voting *)
IF (ABS(rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Lateral_ChB_ms2) <= rTol_AccLateral_ms2) AND
   (ABS(rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Lateral_ChC_ms2) <= rTol_AccLateral_ms2) THEN
    (* Channels A, B, and C all conform within tolerance *)
    rVoted_AccLateral_ms2   := (rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 + rAcc_Lateral_ChB_ms2 + rAcc_Lateral_ChC_ms2) / 3.0;
    bAccLat_ChA_Fault       := FALSE;
    bAccLat_ChB_Fault       := FALSE;
    bAccLat_ChC_Fault       := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Lateral_ChB_ms2) <= rTol_AccLateral_ms2) THEN
    (* Channel C has diverged; degrade to 2oo2 median of A and B *)
    rVoted_AccLateral_ms2   := (rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 + rAcc_Lateral_ChB_ms2) * 0.5;
    bAccLat_ChA_Fault       := FALSE;
    bAccLat_ChB_Fault       := FALSE;
    bAccLat_ChC_Fault       := TRUE;
ELSIF (ABS(rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Lateral_ChC_ms2) <= rTol_AccLateral_ms2) THEN
    (* Channel B has diverged; degrade to 2oo2 median of A and C *)
    rVoted_AccLateral_ms2   := (rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2 + rAcc_Lateral_ChC_ms2) * 0.5;
    bAccLat_ChA_Fault       := FALSE;
    bAccLat_ChB_Fault       := TRUE;
    bAccLat_ChC_Fault       := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rAcc_Lateral_ChB_ms2 - rAcc_Lateral_ChC_ms2) <= rTol_AccLateral_ms2) THEN
    (* Channel A has diverged; degrade to 2oo2 median of B and C *)
    rVoted_AccLateral_ms2   := (rAcc_Lateral_ChB_ms2 + rAcc_Lateral_ChC_ms2) * 0.5;
    bAccLat_ChA_Fault       := TRUE;
    bAccLat_ChB_Fault       := FALSE;
    bAccLat_ChC_Fault       := FALSE;
ELSE
    (* Dual sensor divergence: unrecoverable loss of lateral inertial feedback *)
    rVoted_AccLateral_ms2   := rAcc_Lateral_ChA_ms2;
    bAccLat_ChA_Fault       := TRUE;
    bAccLat_ChB_Fault       := TRUE;
    bAccLat_ChC_Fault       := TRUE;
    wAlarmCriticalWord.1    := TRUE;    (* Alarm Bit 1: Lateral Accelerometer 2oo3 Loss *)
END_IF;

(* 2.2 Vertical Heave Accelerometer Voting *)
IF (ABS(rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Vertical_ChB_ms2) <= rTol_AccVertical_ms2) AND
   (ABS(rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Vertical_ChC_ms2) <= rTol_AccVertical_ms2) THEN
    rVoted_AccVertical_ms2  := (rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 + rAcc_Vertical_ChB_ms2 + rAcc_Vertical_ChC_ms2) / 3.0;
    bAccVert_ChA_Fault      := FALSE;
    bAccVert_ChB_Fault      := FALSE;
    bAccVert_ChC_Fault      := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Vertical_ChB_ms2) <= rTol_AccVertical_ms2) THEN
    rVoted_AccVertical_ms2  := (rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 + rAcc_Vertical_ChB_ms2) * 0.5;
    bAccVert_ChA_Fault      := FALSE;
    bAccVert_ChB_Fault      := FALSE;
    bAccVert_ChC_Fault      := TRUE;
ELSIF (ABS(rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 - rAcc_Vertical_ChC_ms2) <= rTol_AccVertical_ms2) THEN
    rVoted_AccVertical_ms2  := (rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2 + rAcc_Vertical_ChC_ms2) * 0.5;
    bAccVert_ChA_Fault      := FALSE;
    bAccVert_ChB_Fault      := TRUE;
    bAccVert_ChC_Fault      := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rAcc_Vertical_ChB_ms2 - rAcc_Vertical_ChC_ms2) <= rTol_AccVertical_ms2) THEN
    rVoted_AccVertical_ms2  := (rAcc_Vertical_ChB_ms2 + rAcc_Vertical_ChC_ms2) * 0.5;
    bAccVert_ChA_Fault      := TRUE;
    bAccVert_ChB_Fault      := FALSE;
    bAccVert_ChC_Fault      := FALSE;
ELSE
    rVoted_AccVertical_ms2  := rAcc_Vertical_ChA_ms2;
    bAccVert_ChA_Fault      := TRUE;
    bAccVert_ChB_Fault      := TRUE;
    bAccVert_ChC_Fault      := TRUE;
    wAlarmCriticalWord.2    := TRUE;    (* Alarm Bit 2: Vertical Heave Accelerometer 2oo3 Loss *)
END_IF;

(* 2.3 Yaw Rate Gyro Voting *)
IF (ABS(rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads - rGyro_YawRate_ChB_rads) <= rTol_YawRate_rads) AND
   (ABS(rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads - rGyro_YawRate_ChC_rads) <= rTol_YawRate_rads) THEN
    rVoted_YawRate_rads     := (rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads + rGyro_YawRate_ChB_rads + rGyro_YawRate_ChC_rads) / 3.0;
    bYaw_ChA_Fault          := FALSE;
    bYaw_ChB_Fault          := FALSE;
    bYaw_ChC_Fault          := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads - rGyro_YawRate_ChB_rads) <= rTol_YawRate_rads) THEN
    rVoted_YawRate_rads     := (rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads + rGyro_YawRate_ChB_rads) * 0.5;
    bYaw_ChA_Fault          := FALSE;
    bYaw_ChB_Fault          := FALSE;
    bYaw_ChC_Fault          := TRUE;
ELSIF (ABS(rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads - rGyro_YawRate_ChC_rads) <= rTol_YawRate_rads) THEN
    rVoted_YawRate_rads     := (rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads + rGyro_YawRate_ChC_rads) * 0.5;
    bYaw_ChA_Fault          := FALSE;
    bYaw_ChB_Fault          := TRUE;
    bYaw_ChC_Fault          := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rGyro_YawRate_ChB_rads - rGyro_YawRate_ChC_rads) <= rTol_YawRate_rads) THEN
    rVoted_YawRate_rads     := (rGyro_YawRate_ChB_rads + rGyro_YawRate_ChC_rads) * 0.5;
    bYaw_ChA_Fault          := TRUE;
    bYaw_ChB_Fault          := FALSE;
    bYaw_ChC_Fault          := FALSE;
ELSE
    rVoted_YawRate_rads     := rGyro_YawRate_ChA_rads;
    bYaw_ChA_Fault          := TRUE;
    bYaw_ChB_Fault          := TRUE;
    bYaw_ChC_Fault          := TRUE;
    wAlarmCriticalWord.3    := TRUE;    (* Alarm Bit 3: Yaw Rate Gyroscope 2oo3 Loss *)
END_IF;

(* 2.4 Hydraulic Rail Supply Pressure Voting *)
IF (ABS(rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar - rHydSupplyPress_ChB_bar) <= rTol_SupplyPress_bar) AND
   (ABS(rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar - rHydSupplyPress_ChC_bar) <= rTol_SupplyPress_bar) THEN
    rVoted_SupplyPress_bar  := (rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar + rHydSupplyPress_ChB_bar + rHydSupplyPress_ChC_bar) / 3.0;
    bPress_ChA_Fault        := FALSE;
    bPress_ChB_Fault        := FALSE;
    bPress_ChC_Fault        := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar - rHydSupplyPress_ChB_bar) <= rTol_SupplyPress_bar) THEN
    rVoted_SupplyPress_bar  := (rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar + rHydSupplyPress_ChB_bar) * 0.5;
    bPress_ChA_Fault        := FALSE;
    bPress_ChB_Fault        := FALSE;
    bPress_ChC_Fault        := TRUE;
ELSIF (ABS(rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar - rHydSupplyPress_ChC_bar) <= rTol_SupplyPress_bar) THEN
    rVoted_SupplyPress_bar  := (rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar + rHydSupplyPress_ChC_bar) * 0.5;
    bPress_ChA_Fault        := FALSE;
    bPress_ChB_Fault        := TRUE;
    bPress_ChC_Fault        := FALSE;
ELSIF (ABS(rHydSupplyPress_ChB_bar - rHydSupplyPress_ChC_bar) <= rTol_SupplyPress_bar) THEN
    rVoted_SupplyPress_bar  := (rHydSupplyPress_ChB_bar + rHydSupplyPress_ChC_bar) * 0.5;
    bPress_ChA_Fault        := TRUE;
    bPress_ChB_Fault        := FALSE;
    bPress_ChC_Fault        := FALSE;
ELSE
    rVoted_SupplyPress_bar  := rHydSupplyPress_ChA_bar;
    bPress_ChA_Fault        := TRUE;
    bPress_ChB_Fault        := TRUE;
    bPress_ChC_Fault        := TRUE;
    wAlarmCriticalWord.4    := TRUE;    (* Alarm Bit 4: Main Hydraulic Pressure 2oo3 Loss *)
END_IF;

(* Assemble Sensor Health Bitfield Word *)
wSensorHealthWord.0  := NOT bAccLat_ChA_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.1  := NOT bAccLat_ChB_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.2  := NOT bAccLat_ChC_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.3  := NOT bAccVert_ChA_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.4  := NOT bAccVert_ChB_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.5  := NOT bAccVert_ChC_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.6  := NOT bYaw_ChA_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.7  := NOT bYaw_ChB_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.8  := NOT bYaw_ChC_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.9  := NOT bPress_ChA_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.10 := NOT bPress_ChB_Fault;
wSensorHealthWord.11 := NOT bPress_ChC_Fault;

bSensorTmrHealthy := NOT (wAlarmCriticalWord.1 OR wAlarmCriticalWord.2 OR wAlarmCriticalWord.3 OR wAlarmCriticalWord.4);

(* --- SECTION 3: 4-CORNER KINEMATIC DECOUPLING & WARP (ANTI-TWIST) CALCULATION --- *)
(* 3.1 Mean Carbody Height [mm] *)
rCarbodyMeanHeight_mm := (rLVDT_Height_FL_mm + rLVDT_Height_FR_mm +
                          rLVDT_Height_RL_mm + rLVDT_Height_RR_mm) * 0.25;

(* 3.2 Roll Angle Decoupling [mrad]: Positive Left Raised, Right Dropped *)
rCarbodyRoll_mrad := (((rLVDT_Height_FL_mm + rLVDT_Height_RL_mm) -
                       (rLVDT_Height_FR_mm + rLVDT_Height_RR_mm)) * 0.5) / (rConst_LateralHalfWidth_m * 2.0);

(* 3.3 Pitch Angle Decoupling [mrad]: Positive Rear Raised, Front Dropped *)
rCarbodyPitch_mrad := (((rLVDT_Height_RL_mm + rLVDT_Height_RR_mm) -
                        (rLVDT_Height_FL_mm + rLVDT_Height_FR_mm)) * 0.5) / (rConst_BogieHalfBase_m * 2.0);

(* 3.4 Diagonal Suspension Warp (Torsion) Metric [mm] *)
rCarbodyWarp_mm := (rLVDT_Height_FL_mm - rLVDT_Height_FR_mm) - (rLVDT_Height_RL_mm - rLVDT_Height_RR_mm);

(* 3.5 Decoupled Lateral Bogie Displacement & Yaw [mm, mrad] *)
rCarbodyLateral_mm := (rLVDT_Lateral_Front_mm + rLVDT_Lateral_Rear_mm) * 0.5;
rCarbodyYaw_mrad   := (rLVDT_Lateral_Front_mm - rLVDT_Lateral_Rear_mm) / (rConst_BogieHalfBase_m * 2.0);

(* Warp Excursion Safety Check: Prevents unequal bogie load transfer *)
tonWarpExcursionTrip(IN := (ABS(rCarbodyWarp_mm) > 12.0), PT := T#250MS);
bWarpExcursionCritical := tonWarpExcursionTrip.Q;
wAlarmCriticalWord.5   := bWarpExcursionCritical; (* Alarm Bit 5: Suspension Diagonal Warp Limit Exceeded *)

(* --- SECTION 4: 1.25 HZ CARBODY HUNTING SWAY NOTCH FILTER PROCESSING --- *)
(* Direct Form II Transposed IIR Notch Filter for Front Bogie Lateral Accel *)
rFiltered_AccLat_Front := (rNotch_b0 * rVoted_AccLateral_ms2) + rNotch_x1_LatF;
rNotch_x1_LatF         := (rNotch_b1 * rVoted_AccLateral_ms2) - (rNotch_a1 * rFiltered_AccLat_Front) + rNotch_x2_LatF;
rNotch_x2_LatF         := (rNotch_b2 * rVoted_AccLateral_ms2) - (rNotch_a2 * rFiltered_AccLat_Front);

(* Filter for Rear Bogie Lateral Accel Derived from Yaw Rate Derivative *)
rFiltered_AccLat_Rear := (rNotch_b0 * (rVoted_AccLateral_ms2 - (rVoted_YawRate_rads * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m))) + rNotch_x1_LatR;
rNotch_x1_LatR        := (rNotch_b1 * (rVoted_AccLateral_ms2 - (rVoted_YawRate_rads * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m))) - (rNotch_a1 * rFiltered_AccLat_Rear) + rNotch_x2_LatR;
rNotch_x2_LatR        := (rNotch_b2 * (rVoted_AccLateral_ms2 - (rVoted_YawRate_rads * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m))) - (rNotch_a2 * rFiltered_AccLat_Rear);

(* Track Cant Low-Pass Filter *)
IF bTrackDataValid THEN
    rFiltered_TrackCant_rad := (rLPF_Cant_b0 * (rTrackCantAngle_deg * 0.01745329)) + rLPF_Cant_x1;
    rLPF_Cant_x1            := (rLPF_Cant_b1 * (rTrackCantAngle_deg * 0.01745329)) - (rLPF_Cant_a1 * rFiltered_TrackCant_rad) + rLPF_Cant_x2;
    rLPF_Cant_x2            := (rLPF_Cant_b2 * (rTrackCantAngle_deg * 0.01745329)) - (rLPF_Cant_a2 * rFiltered_TrackCant_rad);
ELSE
    rFiltered_TrackCant_rad := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* --- SECTION 5: 10-STATE KALMAN FILTER OBSERVER UPDATE STEP --- *)
(* 5.1 Prediction Step: Prior Estimation Using System Matrix and Control Inputs *)
x_prd_zHeave_m        := (rAd_Heave_Damping * x_est_zHeave_m) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * x_est_vHeave_ms);
x_prd_vHeave_ms       := (rAd_Heave_Damping * x_est_vHeave_ms) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * (rU_Gen_Heave_kN * 1000.0 / rConst_MassCarbody_kg));
x_prd_phiRoll_rad      := (rAd_Roll_Damping * x_est_phiRoll_rad) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * x_est_omegaRoll_rads);
x_prd_omegaRoll_rads   := (rAd_Roll_Damping * x_est_omegaRoll_rads) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * (rU_Gen_Roll_kNm * 1000.0 / rConst_InertiaRoll_kgm2));
x_prd_thetaPitch_rad   := (rAd_Pitch_Damping * x_est_thetaPitch_rad) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * x_est_omegaPitch_rads);
x_prd_omegaPitch_rads  := (rAd_Pitch_Damping * x_est_omegaPitch_rads) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * (rU_Gen_Pitch_kNm * 1000.0 / rConst_InertiaPitch_kgm2));
x_prd_yLateral_m       := (rAd_Lateral_Damping * x_est_yLateral_m) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * x_est_vLateral_ms);
x_prd_vLateral_ms      := (rAd_Lateral_Damping * x_est_vLateral_ms) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * (rU_Gen_Lateral_kN * 1000.0 / rConst_MassCarbody_kg));
x_prd_psiYaw_rad       := (rAd_Yaw_Damping * x_est_psiYaw_rad) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * x_est_omegaYaw_rads);
x_prd_omegaYaw_rads    := (rAd_Yaw_Damping * x_est_omegaYaw_rads) + (rConst_SampleTime_s * (rU_Gen_Yaw_kNm * 1000.0 / rConst_InertiaYaw_kgm2));

(* 5.2 Measurement Innovation & Correction *)
x_est_zHeave_m        := x_prd_zHeave_m + (rL_Heave_Pos * ((rCarbodyMeanHeight_mm - rConst_NominalHeight_mm) * 0.001 - x_prd_zHeave_m));
x_est_vHeave_ms       := x_prd_vHeave_ms + (rL_Heave_Vel * (rVoted_AccVertical_ms2 * rConst_SampleTime_s - x_prd_vHeave_ms));
x_est_phiRoll_rad      := x_prd_phiRoll_rad + (rL_Roll_Angle * (rCarbodyRoll_mrad * 0.001 - x_prd_phiRoll_rad));
x_est_omegaRoll_rads   := x_prd_omegaRoll_rads + (rL_Roll_Vel * ((rCarbodyRoll_mrad * 0.001 - x_prd_phiRoll_rad) / rConst_SampleTime_s - x_prd_omegaRoll_rads));
x_est_thetaPitch_rad   := x_prd_thetaPitch_rad + (rL_Pitch_Angle * (rCarbodyPitch_mrad * 0.001 - x_prd_thetaPitch_rad));
x_est_omegaPitch_rads  := x_prd_omegaPitch_rads + (rL_Pitch_Vel * ((rCarbodyPitch_mrad * 0.001 - x_prd_thetaPitch_rad) / rConst_SampleTime_s - x_prd_omegaPitch_rads));
x_est_yLateral_m       := x_prd_yLateral_m + (rL_Lateral_Pos * (rCarbodyLateral_mm * 0.001 - x_prd_yLateral_m));
x_est_vLateral_ms      := x_prd_vLateral_ms + (rL_Lateral_Vel * (rFiltered_AccLat_Front * rConst_SampleTime_s - x_prd_vLateral_ms));
x_est_psiYaw_rad       := x_prd_psiYaw_rad + (rL_Yaw_Angle * (rCarbodyYaw_mrad * 0.001 - x_prd_psiYaw_rad));
x_est_omegaYaw_rads    := x_prd_omegaYaw_rads + (rL_Yaw_Vel * (rVoted_YawRate_rads - x_prd_omegaYaw_rads));

(* --- SECTION 6: HIGH-SPEED CURVE TILTING & CENTRIFUGAL COMPENSATION --- *)
IF bTrackDataValid AND (ABS(rTrackCurvature_inv_m) > 0.00001) AND (rTrainSpeed_kmh > 40.0) THEN
    (* Train Velocity in m/s: v = Speed_kmh / 3.6 *)
    (* Centrifugal Lateral Acceleration: a_c = v^2 * Curvature *)
    rComp_CentrifugalForce_kN := (rConst_MassCarbody_kg * EXPT(rTrainSpeed_kmh / 3.6, 2.0) * rTrackCurvature_inv_m) * 0.001;
    (* Equilibrium Tilt Angle to cancel lateral passenger feeling: theta = a_c / g - cant *)
    rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad := (EXPT(rTrainSpeed_kmh / 3.6, 2.0) * rTrackCurvature_inv_m / rConst_Gravity_ms2) - rFiltered_TrackCant_rad;
    (* Clamp Maximum Tilting to +/- 85 mrad (+/- 4.87 deg) *)
    IF rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad > 0.085 THEN
        rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad := 0.085;
    ELSIF rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad < -0.085 THEN
        rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad := -0.085;
    END_IF;
    rRef_Roll_rad := rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad;
ELSE
    rComp_CentrifugalForce_kN    := 0.0;
    rComp_SuperelevationTilt_rad := 0.0;
    rRef_Roll_rad                := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Gain Scheduling with Train Speed *)
IF rTrainSpeed_kmh > 10.0 THEN
    rSpeedRatio := rTrainSpeed_kmh / 600.0;
    IF rSpeedRatio > 1.0 THEN
        rSpeedRatio := 1.0;
    END_IF;
    rDampingGainScale := 1.0 + (0.85 * rSpeedRatio); (* Increase damping stiffness by up to 85% at 600 km/h *)
ELSE
    rDampingGainScale := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Set Target Heave Reference with TCMS Height Bias *)
rRef_Heave_m := rTargetHeightBias_mm * 0.001;

(* Anti-Twist (Warp) Correction Force *)
rComp_WarpRestoration_kN := (rCarbodyWarp_mm * 0.001) * 350.0; (* 350 kN/m anti-twist stiffness *)

(* --- SECTION 7: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) GENERALIZED FORCE SYNTHESIS --- *)
(* Heave Modal Force Synthesis *)
rU_Gen_Heave_kN := -((rK_mpc_Heave_P * (x_est_zHeave_m - rRef_Heave_m)) +
                     (rK_mpc_Heave_D * rDampingGainScale * x_est_vHeave_ms)) * 0.001;

(* Roll Modal Moment Synthesis with Tilt Feedforward *)
rU_Gen_Roll_kNm := -((rK_mpc_Roll_P * (x_est_phiRoll_rad - rRef_Roll_rad)) +
                     (rK_mpc_Roll_D * rDampingGainScale * x_est_omegaRoll_rads)) * 0.001;

(* Pitch Modal Moment Synthesis *)
rU_Gen_Pitch_kNm := -((rK_mpc_Pitch_P * (x_est_thetaPitch_rad - rRef_Pitch_rad)) +
                      (rK_mpc_Pitch_D * rDampingGainScale * x_est_omegaPitch_rads)) * 0.001;

(* Lateral Sway Modal Force Synthesis with Centrifugal Feedforward *)
rU_Gen_Lateral_kN := -((rK_mpc_Lat_P * (x_est_yLateral_m - rRef_Lateral_m)) +
                       (rK_mpc_Lat_D * rDampingGainScale * x_est_vLateral_ms)) * 0.001 + rComp_CentrifugalForce_kN;

(* Yaw Damping Modal Moment Synthesis *)
rU_Gen_Yaw_kNm := -((rK_mpc_Yaw_P * (x_est_psiYaw_rad - rRef_Yaw_rad)) +
                    (rK_mpc_Yaw_D * rDampingGainScale * x_est_omegaYaw_rads)) * 0.001;

(* --- SECTION 8: 4-CORNER VERTICAL ACTUATOR & 2-LATERAL ACTUATOR FORCE ALLOCATION --- *)
(* Normal Leveling Cylinder Forces [kN] *)
rDemandedForce_FL_kN := (rU_Gen_Heave_kN * 0.25) +
                        (rU_Gen_Roll_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_LateralHalfWidth_m)) -
                        (rU_Gen_Pitch_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m)) +
                        (rComp_WarpRestoration_kN * 0.25);

rDemandedForce_FR_kN := (rU_Gen_Heave_kN * 0.25) -
                        (rU_Gen_Roll_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_LateralHalfWidth_m)) -
                        (rU_Gen_Pitch_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m)) -
                        (rComp_WarpRestoration_kN * 0.25);

rDemandedForce_RL_kN := (rU_Gen_Heave_kN * 0.25) +
                        (rU_Gen_Roll_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_LateralHalfWidth_m)) +
                        (rU_Gen_Pitch_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m)) -
                        (rComp_WarpRestoration_kN * 0.25);

rDemandedForce_RR_kN := (rU_Gen_Heave_kN * 0.25) -
                        (rU_Gen_Roll_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_LateralHalfWidth_m)) +
                        (rU_Gen_Pitch_kNm / (4.0 * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m)) +
                        (rComp_WarpRestoration_kN * 0.25);

(* Front and Rear Lateral Actuator Damping Demands [kN] *)
rDemandedForce_LatF_kN := (rU_Gen_Lateral_kN * 0.5) + (rU_Gen_Yaw_kNm / (2.0 * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m));
rDemandedForce_LatR_kN := (rU_Gen_Lateral_kN * 0.5) - (rU_Gen_Yaw_kNm / (2.0 * rConst_BogieHalfBase_m));

(* Force Clamping: Ensure Cylinder Forces Remain Within Structural Limits [-65 kN, +65 kN] *)
IF rDemandedForce_FL_kN > 65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_FL_kN := 65.0;
ELSIF rDemandedForce_FL_kN < -65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_FL_kN := -65.0;
END_IF;

IF rDemandedForce_FR_kN > 65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_FR_kN := 65.0;
ELSIF rDemandedForce_FR_kN < -65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_FR_kN := -65.0;
END_IF;

IF rDemandedForce_RL_kN > 65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_RL_kN := 65.0;
ELSIF rDemandedForce_RL_kN < -65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_RL_kN := -65.0;
END_IF;

IF rDemandedForce_RR_kN > 65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_RR_kN := 65.0;
ELSIF rDemandedForce_RR_kN < -65.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_RR_kN := -65.0;
END_IF;

IF rDemandedForce_LatF_kN > 45.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_LatF_kN := 45.0;
ELSIF rDemandedForce_LatF_kN < -45.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_LatF_kN := -45.0;
END_IF;

IF rDemandedForce_LatR_kN > 45.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_LatR_kN := 45.0;
ELSIF rDemandedForce_LatR_kN < -45.0 THEN
    rDemandedForce_LatR_kN := -45.0;
END_IF;

(* --- SECTION 9: NONLINEAR ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC VALVE CURRENT SYNTHESIS --- *)
(* Orifice Area & Differential Pressure Inverse Model: I = F / (Area * dP) * K_valve *)
IF rVoted_SupplyPress_bar > rConst_HydSupplyMin_bar THEN
    (* Vertical Cylinders Current Output [-40.0 mA to +40.0 mA] *)
    rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA := (rDemandedForce_FL_kN * 1000.0) / (rConst_CylinderAreaVert_m2 * (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar - rHydReturnPress_bar) * 100000.0) * 40.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA := (rDemandedForce_FR_kN * 1000.0) / (rConst_CylinderAreaVert_m2 * (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar - rHydReturnPress_bar) * 100000.0) * 40.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA := (rDemandedForce_RL_kN * 1000.0) / (rConst_CylinderAreaVert_m2 * (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar - rHydReturnPress_bar) * 100000.0) * 40.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA := (rDemandedForce_RR_kN * 1000.0) / (rConst_CylinderAreaVert_m2 * (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar - rHydReturnPress_bar) * 100000.0) * 40.0;

    (* Lateral Damping Cylinders Current Output [-40.0 mA to +40.0 mA] *)
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA := (rDemandedForce_LatF_kN * 1000.0) / (rConst_CylinderAreaLat_m2 * (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar - rHydReturnPress_bar) * 100000.0) * 40.0;
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA  := (rDemandedForce_LatR_kN * 1000.0) / (rConst_CylinderAreaLat_m2 * (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar - rHydReturnPress_bar) * 100000.0) * 40.0;
ELSE
    rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA     := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA := 0.0;
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA  := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Clamp Drive Currents to Hardware Coil Saturation Limits [-40.0 mA, +40.0 mA] *)
IF rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA > 40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA := 40.0;
ELSIF rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA < -40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA := -40.0;
END_IF;

IF rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA > 40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA := 40.0;
ELSIF rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA < -40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA := -40.0;
END_IF;

IF rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA > 40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA := 40.0;
ELSIF rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA < -40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA := -40.0;
END_IF;

IF rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA > 40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA := 40.0;
ELSIF rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA < -40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA := -40.0;
END_IF;

IF rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA > 40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA := 40.0;
ELSIF rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA < -40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA := -40.0;
END_IF;

IF rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA > 40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA := 40.0;
ELSIF rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA < -40.0 THEN
    rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA := -40.0;
END_IF;

(* --- SECTION 10: CONTINUOUS SPERLING RIDE COMFORT EVALUATION (ISO 2631 / DIN EN 12299) --- *)
rAcc_SumSquares := rAcc_SumSquares + EXPT(rVoted_AccLateral_ms2, 2.0) + EXPT(rVoted_AccVertical_ms2, 2.0);
iSampleIndex_Comfort := iSampleIndex_Comfort + 1;
IF iSampleIndex_Comfort >= 500 THEN (* 500 scans * 0.002s = 1.0 second evaluation window *)
    rRmsAcceleration := SQRT(rAcc_SumSquares / 1000.0);
    IF rRmsAcceleration > 0.001 THEN
        rComfortIndex_Sperling := 4.42 * EXPT(rRmsAcceleration, 0.3);
    ELSE
        rComfortIndex_Sperling := 1.0;
    END_IF;
    rAcc_SumSquares      := 0.0;
    iSampleIndex_Comfort := 0;
END_IF;

(* --- SECTION 11: MULTI-STAGE SYSTEM SEQUENCER & GRACEFUL DEGRADATION FINITE STATE MACHINE --- *)
tonPowerUpDelay(IN := (iActiveState = 0), PT := T#1000MS);
tonHydraulicPressDelay(IN := (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar >= rConst_HydSupplyNom_bar * 0.90), PT := T#1500MS);
tonLevelingHomingTimeout(IN := (iActiveState = 30), PT := T#10S);

CASE iActiveState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & BOOT INTEGRITY CHECK *)
        bSystemReady           := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive    := FALSE;
        bFailsafeLockoutActive := FALSE;
        rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA    := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA    := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA    := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA    := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA:= 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA := 0.0;

        IF tonPowerUpDelay.Q AND bMasterEnable THEN
            iActiveState := 10; (* Proceed to 2oo3 Sensor Pre-check *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: 2oo3 SENSOR SUITE VERIFICATION & CALIBRATION *)
        IF bSensorTmrHealthy THEN
            iActiveState := 20; (* Proceed to Hydraulic Pressurization Check *)
        ELSE
            wAlarmCriticalWord.6 := TRUE; (* Alarm Bit 6: Sensor Suite Calibration Failed *)
            iActiveState := 70;         (* Go to Lockout *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: HYDRAULIC LINE PRESSURE STABILIZATION *)
        IF tonHydraulicPressDelay.Q THEN
            bHydraulicPressureNominal := TRUE;
            iActiveState := 30;         (* Proceed to Static Height Homing *)
        ELSIF rVoted_SupplyPress_bar < rConst_HydSupplyMin_bar THEN
            wAlarmCriticalWord.7 := TRUE; (* Alarm Bit 7: Hydraulic Line Pressure Underrange *)
            iActiveState := 70;         (* Abort to Lockout *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: STATIC 4-CORNER HEIGHT LEVELING & ANTI-TWIST HOMING *)
        (* Check if carbody height is within +/- 2.0 mm of nominal and warp is < 3.0 mm *)
        IF (ABS(rCarbodyMeanHeight_mm - (rConst_NominalHeight_mm + rTargetHeightBias_mm)) < 2.0) AND
           (ABS(rCarbodyWarp_mm) < 3.0) AND
           (ABS(rCarbodyRoll_mrad) < 2.0) AND
           (ABS(rCarbodyPitch_mrad) < 2.0) THEN
            bHomingCompleted := TRUE;
            iActiveState     := 40;     (* Enter Fully Active Synchronous Cruising *)
        ELSIF tonLevelingHomingTimeout.Q THEN
            wAlarmDegradedWord.0 := TRUE; (* Warning Bit 0: Homing Time Extended, Forcing Active *)
            iActiveState         := 40;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: FULL ACTIVE HIGH-SPEED SYNCHRONOUS CRUISE & SWAY DAMPING *)
        bSystemReady           := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive    := FALSE;
        bFailsafeLockoutActive := FALSE;

        (* Dynamic Condition Check: Curve Tilting Detection *)
        IF bTrackDataValid AND (ABS(rTrackCurvature_inv_m) > 0.00015) AND (rTrainSpeed_kmh > 80.0) THEN
            iActiveState := 50; (* Transition to Active Curve Tilting Mode *)
        END_IF;

        (* Degraded Mode Supervision *)
        IF (bAccLat_ChA_Fault OR bAccLat_ChB_Fault OR bAccLat_ChC_Fault OR
            bYaw_ChA_Fault OR bYaw_ChB_Fault OR bYaw_ChC_Fault) THEN
            wAlarmDegradedWord.1 := TRUE; (* Warning Bit 1: Single Sensor Degraded, Downgrading to Skyhook *)
            iActiveState := 60;          (* Fallback to Degraded Semi-Active Skyhook Mode *)
        END_IF;

        (* Critical System Abort Check *)
        IF (wAlarmCriticalWord <> 16#0000) OR NOT bMasterEnable OR (rVoted_SupplyPress_bar < rConst_HydSupplyMin_bar) THEN
            iActiveState := 70; (* Critical Fault: Lockout *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: HIGH-SPEED CURVE TILTING & TRACK CANT SYNCHRONIZATION *)
        bSystemReady           := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive    := FALSE;
        bFailsafeLockoutActive := FALSE;

        (* Revert to Cruising when track curvature straightens *)
        IF (ABS(rTrackCurvature_inv_m) <= 0.00005) OR (rTrainSpeed_kmh <= 60.0) THEN
            iActiveState := 40; (* Revert to Standard Cruise Mode *)
        END_IF;

        (* Critical System Abort Check *)
        IF (wAlarmCriticalWord <> 16#0000) OR NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iActiveState := 70;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION: SEMI-ACTIVE SKYHOOK DAMPING FALLBACK *)
        (* Reduced gain operation with secondary air-spring passive ride height *)
        bSystemReady           := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive    := TRUE;
        bFailsafeLockoutActive := FALSE;

        (* Attenuate Valve Currents by 50% to prevent instability during degraded sensing *)
        rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA     := rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA * 0.5;
        rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA     := rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA * 0.5;
        rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA     := rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA * 0.5;
        rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA     := rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA * 0.5;
        rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA := rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA * 0.5;
        rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA  := rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA * 0.5;

        (* If sensor integrity is restored and reset commanded *)
        IF bSensorTmrHealthy AND bResetFaults THEN
            wAlarmDegradedWord.1 := FALSE;
            iActiveState         := 40; (* Restore Full Active Cruising *)
        END_IF;

        IF (wAlarmCriticalWord <> 16#0000) OR NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iActiveState := 70;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: HYDROMECHANICAL FAIL-SAFE LOCKOUT & BUMPSTOP LANDING *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        bFailsafeLockoutActive  := TRUE;

        (* All Valve Drive Currents Clamped to Null (0.0 mA) *)
        rI_Cmd_Height_FL_mA     := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_Height_FR_mA     := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_Height_RL_mA     := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_Height_RR_mA     := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Front_mA := 0.0;
        rI_Cmd_LatDamp_Rear_mA  := 0.0;

        (* Re-latching & Recovery Permissive Logic *)
        IF bMasterEnable AND bEmergencyStop AND (wAlarmCriticalWord = 16#0000) AND bResetFaults THEN
            bFailsafeLockoutActive := FALSE;
            iActiveState           := 0; (* Return to Initialization *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* --- SECTION 12: STATUS WORD ASSEMBLY & TELEMETRY BROADCAST --- *)
wSystemStatusWord.0 := bSystemReady;
wSystemStatusWord.1 := bDegradedModeActive;
wSystemStatusWord.2 := bFailsafeLockoutActive;
wSystemStatusWord.3 := (iActiveState = 40); (* In Full Cruise *)
wSystemStatusWord.4 := (iActiveState = 50); (* In Active Tilting *)
wSystemStatusWord.5 := bStationLevelingCmd;
wSystemStatusWord.6 := bManualOverride;
wSystemStatusWord.7 := bHomingCompleted;
wSystemStatusWord.8 := bHydraulicPressureNominal;
wSystemStatusWord.9 := bTrackDataValid;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
